title: GrowthBook hero
description: A centred, airy product hero: a big regular-weight two-line headline in navy, a short grey lead, an outline and a violet button, then a wide rounded gradient panel holding a dark segmented tab switch and a product screenshot that rises from the panel's bottom edge. Tabs swap the screenshot.
notes: each tab has its own media slot (screenshot); empty slots show a plain card-coloured placeholder at 1.94:1
the panel backdrop is a soft glow/primary/highlight gradient unless a backdrop is passed
phones hide the tab switch and show the panel full-bleed, as on the original
